session.title: Rest or short Enduro-eve primer
session.purpose: Protect Friday morning's Enduro quality while allowing a tiny rhythm-preserving touch if restlessness, not fatigue, is present.
session.dose: Prefer rest. Optional 20-25 minutes at 105-115 W and RPE 1-2 only with green readiness, normal CNS and fresh legs.
session.adaptation_hypothesis: Removing Thursday load preserves race-bike perception-action quality better than adding fitness work this close to Friday.
execution_rules: No torque, cadence drill, tempo, strength or mobility loading that can create fatigue.

expected_result.next_day: Friday starts with clear cognition and fresh upper and lower body.

stop_rules: Any fatigue signal converts the day to complete rest.
